method: Assistant inspected source grid and native crops, mask overlay, full-composition native samples at 0/8 seconds, six-state waterfall/lamp temporal crops, ten original/forced-dim window pairs, isolated encoded full frames, and complete-preview colour-aware decoded frames at 8 and 40 seconds.
observations: Upper cloud features change position while window/city composition stays fixed. The initial narrow exclusions sampled small architecture fragments; the revised source exclusion and lower skyline boundary remove the observed artifacts in inspected samples.
Waterfall channel outlines and ledges remain fixed while internal texture changes. Separate numerical tracking confirms a downward displacement of eight native pixels over 0.2 seconds.
Basin reflections are calmer than waterfall texture; some source reflection detail is softened by the reconstructed-water method. Calmness and naturalness remain for user playback review.
Forced-dim selected panes include their bright cores; adjacent unselected windows remain lit. The surrounding facade is not broadly dimmed.
Monitor retains its map and bezel with small route/node/panel changes. The lamp sample at 32.1 seconds dims the emitter and its nearby warm pool without a whole-frame exposure change.
Decoded samples retain the cyan/amber colour balance, dry desk, corrected beaker and static skyline composition. No new vehicles, rain, lightning or camera movement were added.
status: Draft delivered for real-time user review; no artistic approval inferred
